thread:
Sarah R: Ping — kicking off network preflight for MeridianBank POC. They want Private deployment in their VPC but require egress via their SNI proxy and static IPs for allowlist. Need checklist and example SGs/policy we can hand to their netops.

Leo K: Quick clarifying q — PrivateLink only (interface endpoints) or any peering allowed? Customer doc earlier said "no peering across corp".

Marta V: They confirmed no peering. Plan: we expose an interface service they accept; runtime nodes will initiate outbound to their onprem SNI proxy (TLS 443). For static egress we can allocate EIPs on our NAT gateways in their account or run an outbound proxy appliance in their VPC.

Jin P: Security items: they want CloudTrail + VPC Flow Logs forwarded to their SIEM S3. Also need KMS: do they want customer-managed key? If yes, we'll need cross-account grants.

Alex (AM): Also asked about pricing impact if we use PrivateLink vs peering. They want to know if traffic costs change.

Leo K: From our side: pricing doesn't change on our per-node/reserved billing. For them, PrivateLink traffic may incur interface endpoint and cross-AZ data charges depending on AWS region. We'll add a note.

Marta V: Firewall example snippet to give their netops:
```
# Allow inbound only from VPC endpoints (interface ENIs)
Allow: 10.200.0.0/22 TCP 443

# Outbound from runtime -> customer SNI proxy
Allow: 198.51.100.42 TCP 443 (customer-proxy.example.com)

# Optional debug SSH (discouraged)
Allow: 198.51.100.43 TCP 2200 (jumpbox)
```

Jin P: For cross-account S3 write we can provide an example bucket policy and IAM role. Also we'll need their SIEM bucket ARN and the prefix they want. Pen-test attestation requested too.

Sarah R: Draft preflight I'll send to MeridianBank — thoughts on static EIP ops? Do we need per-AZ EIPs or a regional pair?

Leo K: Recommend per-region pair (one per AZ we operate in) to avoid SNAT overload. Need throughput numbers to size NATs and estimate costs. Ask customer for peak tps and sustained bandwidth.

Marta V: Also flag latency: if their SNI proxy is onprem and traffic routes over internet, latency may be higher. If they want low-latency internal routing, they could colocate their proxy in same region.

Alex (AM): I'll push for throughput numbers and SIEM contact. They also want an estimated timeline for smoke tests once we have endpoints and EIPs.

Deploy Bot: Reminder — POC workspace 7721 created; credentials expire in 12 days :warning:

Sarah R: Next steps (our side):
- Leo: compute EIP/cost estimate + NAT sizing (ETA EOD)
- Marta: produce SG/Privatelink creation example + bucket policy snippet (ETA EOD)
- Jin: KMS cross-account guide + checklist for logs & pen-test (ETA tomorrow)

Marta V: Example AWS PrivateLink command to hand to their cloud team:
```
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0abc1234 --service-name com.amazonaws.vpce.us-west-2.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --subnet-ids subnet-111,subnet-222 --security-group-ids sg-aaaa1111
```

Leo K: If they require mutual TLS between control plane and runtime, we support mTLS but that's an ops uplift (cert rotation, distribution). Mentioned this to security.

Sarah R: Great. I'll send the preflight + ask for exact allowlist IPs, throughput per region, and SIEM bucket ARN. Will CC their network lead. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
